description: Batch-wise availability for a stock (all variants' batches). Prefer {@code GET /availability?isVariant=false}. Part of the Availability APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

warehouseUniqueName.description: Warehouse unique name query parameter. Optional.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Optional.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: expiryDate. Optional.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: asc. Optional.
